text:
Nina Patel: FYI: AcmeHealth says their QRadar instance hasn't seen audit events for tenant=acme-health since our KMS rotation yesterday. Raising an escalation — customer ticket SUP-4527. @Jon Rivera can you look? export-forwarder logs show manifest fetch 404.

Jon Rivera: On it. Is this only QRadar or are other SIEM sinks affected?

Nina Patel: Customer confirmed only QRadar. Our Splunk connector and the S3 destination look normal. They forwarded QRadar ingest errors: 'received manifest missing key material' (screenshot pasted).

SecBot: ALERT export-forwarder-retry count=3 tenant=acme-health key=projects/redwood/kms/aliases/audit-export-2026 rotation=2026-03-15T21:03:58Z

Jon Rivera: Can you paste the export-forwarder logs around the rotation time? need stack/context for decrypt failures.

Nina Patel: Log snippet pasted below:
```log
2026-03-15T21:04:12Z export-forwarder ERROR manifest fetch 404 tenant=acme-health manifest_path=s3://audit-exports/acme-health/2026-03-15/manifest.json err=NoKmsKey
2026-03-15T21:04:13Z export-forwarder WARN retrying (attempt 2)
2026-03-15T21:04:16Z export-forwarder ERROR decrypt failed key=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/old-key-id err=AccessDenied
```

Priya Sharma: Looks like the KMS alias rotation at 2026-03-15T21:03:58Z changed the underlying HSM key ID. Our forwarder caches the CMK ARN and attempted to decrypt with the old key, which fails (KMS returns NotFound/AccessDenied).

Marco Diaz: Customer timeline: they rotated their QRadar connector at ~21:30 local, but missing events are for window 21:03–21:20. That matches rotation time.

Jon Rivera: Hypothesis: manifest files were re-encrypted (or had envelope metadata) with the new CMK, but the forwarder attempted to use cached old ARN for signing/decrypt. Need to repro with curl from a forwarder node.

Nina Patel: Repro steps I ran locally: 
```bash
curl -H "X-Export-Auth: forwarder-token" https://export-internal.redwood/tenant/acme-health/manifest/2026-03-15
# response: 404 + header X-KMS-Err: key_not_found
```

Priya Sharma: Proposed plan: 1) brief IAM exception to allow export-forwarder service account to list/describe KMS aliases for 2 hours (audit recorded). 2) Run an S3 -> QRadar backfill using the replay tool to push the missing window. 3) Patch forwarder to refresh alias/CMK on alias change events and add retry/backoff for KMS NotFound.

Marco Diaz: Customer asked for ETA for backfill. Estimated window size ~17k events; QRadar ingestion should handle that. We need ops approval for pushing to their QRadar endpoint.

Jon Rivera: I can run the replay tool and validate manifests. Will need the temporary IAM exception and export-forwarder logs forwarded to me. Starting in ~30m if approved.

Priya Sharma: Approving 2-hour read-only IAM permission to allow alias/describe for export-forwarder: action=kms:DescribeKey,kms:ListAliases resource=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/* condition=TimeLessThan(2h). I'll open a short-lived authorization in IAM and document the audit. Also creating a follow-up to add alias-drift alert to Console.

Nina Patel: Thanks. I'll update AcmeHealth with preliminary ETA (2–3 hours for replay). Logging planned actions in SUP-4527 and will attach replay summary when done.

Jon Rivera: Starting replay now. Will post results + verification steps (search by tenant_id and event_id range) when complete.

Priya Sharma: After replay, we'll run a postmortem: cause=KMS alias rotation + forwarder cache; actions=IAM exception policy, forwarder patch, Console alert.

Nina Patel: :thumbsup: Marking as high-priority and adding to Monday on-call follow-up.
